description: Cubic metres, weight and truck loads of snow from a lot area and snow depth, with the footprint and base width of a snow pile of a chosen height. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Planning estimate only. Real snow varies with temperature, wind, rain and time on the ground, and real piles are windrows, not cones. Weigh or measure loads when it matters, for example for roof loads or truck limits.

area.description: Area to be cleared. Unit: m2 or sq ft.

depth.description: Depth of snow to be cleared. Unit: cm or in.

pile_height.description: Height of the snow pile on site. Unit: m or ft.

truck.description: Volume of one truck load. 15 is an example; enter your hauler's figure. Unit: m3.

units.description: Units for area and pile height. Area is square metres or square feet.

volume_factor.description: Multiplier on the fallen volume for plowed or loosened snow. 1 means the same volume as fallen. Set it from your contractor's experience.
